claim: A GeV-scale ALP with flavour-violating couplings to right-handed up-type quarks ('charming ALP') allows t -> a q (q=u,c). For m_a ~ 1-10 GeV the ALP is naturally long-lived (c tau ~ cm-m), so a top-triggered ttbar search for an ALP decaying in the HCAL (CalRatio-like: high E_had/E_em, track veto) or in the muon system probes Br(t->aq) < 1e-4 (Run 3, conservative) and, if background-free, ~1e-7 (Run 3) to ~1e-8 (HL-LHC). Single-top recasts cover only the very short and very long c tau limits at the ~1e-3 level (arXiv:2202.09371 abstract, Sec. 4.3, App. A).
framework: Dimension-5 derivative ALP EFT L = (d_mu a/f_a) (c_uR)_ij ubar_Ri gamma^mu u_Rj with hermitian c_uR (2202.09371 Eq. 2.1-2.2); UV completions: t-channel flavoured dark-QCD sectors (dark pions) or Froggatt-Nielsen models where only RH up quarks are charged (2101.07803). Couplings to gluons, photons, leptons and down-type FCNC arise only through loops / RG running (2110.10698 Eqs. 2.15-2.21, 2.31).
assumptions: ALP couples at tree level only to RH up-type quarks; c_GG, c_gamma gamma, lepton couplings vanish at the UV scale.
(c_uR)_12 tiny (D0-D0bar mixing, 2101.07803 Sec. IV.A); (c_uR)_13,23 ~ O(1) relative to f_a.
Benchmark of 2202.09371 sets all diagonal entries equal (c_ii) and all t-q entries equal (c_3q); lifetime set by c_ii, Br(t->aq) by c_3q/f_a.
m_a >~ 1 GeV so that perturbative QCD / quark-hadron duality is used for hadronic widths (2202.09371 Sec. 2).
No other light dark-sector states (otherwise t -> emerging jet, 2202.09371 Sec. 5).
controlling_parameters: (c_uR)_ii / f_a (esp. c_cc, c_uu, c_tt via running) -> c tau
UV scale Lambda (log-sensitivity of loop-induced lepton/photon couplings)
robust_predictions: Production via ttbar with one t -> a q: single displaced object recoiling against a light jet, with m(a + j) = m_t if the LLP four-momentum is measured; the other top provides the trigger.

ALP highly boosted (m_a << m_t), decays to a narrow single-jet-like object; for m_a > 2 m_c dominantly a -> c cbar (tree level), cf. ATLAS benchmark Br(cc)~75%, Br(gg)~25% at m_a=40-55 GeV (2403.15332).
At fixed (c_ii/c_3q) ratio, c tau scales as 1/Br(t->aq): long lifetimes and large exotic branching ratios are anti-correlated unless off-diagonal >> diagonal couplings (2202.09371 Fig. 1 right).
BBN/cosmology irrelevant for c tau <~ 100 m (tau << 1 s).
model_dependent_predictions: The c tau - Br(t->aq) relation (depends on ratio c_ii/c_3q, i.e. on UV flavour structure).

ALP branching ratios for 1 GeV < m_a < 2 m_c: 2202.09371 Fig. 1 (f_a = 1e6 GeV) shows hadrons dominant with Br(gamma gamma) ~ O(0.3-0.6) and Br(mu mu) ~ 1e-3, whereas 2110.10698 Sec. 3.8.4 (Lambda = 4 pi TeV, universal c_u) states leptonic channels dominate for 2 m_e < m_a < few GeV. Visible channel at m_a ~ 1-3 GeV is therefore theory-uncertain at order-of-magnitude level.
Displaced a -> gamma gamma / mu mu from top decays: only sizeable below the charm threshold, or with extra c_gamma gamma / lepton couplings outside the minimal model.
Low-mass (m_a < m_B - m_K) parameter space is subject to B -> K(*) a(mu mu) and Upsilon/J/psi -> gamma a constraints on c_tt and c_cc (2110.10698 Fig. 23).

theory_uncertainties: Hadronic ALP width for 1 GeV <~ m_a <~ 3 GeV (duality vs chiral/data-driven treatments): changes c tau and visible channel by large factors.
Log(Lambda) dependence of loop-induced lepton/photon couplings (f_a = 1e6 GeV vs Lambda = 4 pi TeV conventions differ between 2202.09371 and 2110.10698).

Mapping of (Br, c tau) to UV couplings depends on unknown flavour structure; the signal itself (ttbar x Br, LLP kinematics) is well predicted (ttbar cross section known at percent level, UNVERIFIED number).
CalRatio efficiency modelled via a published ATLAS efficiency map in 2202.09371, not full simulation; background-free projections (1e-7 / 1e-8) are optimistic assumptions by the authors.
distinctiveness: Single displaced hadronic (or for m_a < 2 m_c photon/muon) object plus a light jet reconstructing m_t, in ttbar with a leptonic top. Distinct from h->aa (two LLPs, m=125 GeV), W/Z+a, and emerging jets. Not distinguishable from any other t -> q X(LLP) (e.g. flavour-violating light scalar, CP not measured), so results should be quoted model-independently as Br(t->qX) vs (m_X, c tau).
caveats: Proposed target (m_a ~ 1-35 GeV, HCAL/MS, lepton-triggered ttbar) is theoretically consistent and largely free of flavour/cosmology constraints for m_a >~ 5 GeV; at m_a = 2 GeV B->K a(mu mu) must be checked quantitatively.

Large-Br + long-lifetime corner presupposes an inverted coupling hierarchy (off-diagonal >> diagonal) that is not generic; generic UV completions put the signal at Br <~ 1e-6-1e-8, i.e. the reach of a near background-free HL-LHC search.
Leptonic/photonic ALP channel sub-target is strongly model-dependent; do not use the minimal charming-ALP model to motivate a -> gamma gamma above 2 m_c.
Figure readings (Fig. 1 of 2202.09371, Fig. 23 of 2110.10698) are approximate.
